prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, expression, hair and clothing reference, Nastya Tsupik. Image 2 provides ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil medium, real feline anatomy, clean bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's face, light eyes, shoulder-length straight hair, smile shape or black T-shirt. This is a DIFFERENT Nastya.
Primary request: reimagine the woman in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve her soft slightly elongated oval face, full smiling cheeks, strong dark gently curved eyebrows, dark brown almond eyes at their original spacing with a natural cheerful squint, broad warm open smile showing the upper teeth, and small gently rounded chin. Keep natural youthful facial proportions and cheerful expression, no glamour makeup, oversized doll eyes or added age. Real short natural feline muzzle, small cat nose and delicate whiskers; muted warm chestnut/taupe fur with cream cheek and muzzle highlights.
Hair: long loose wavy natural chestnut/brown hair with warm auburn undertones, near-center part and soft curved curtain strands framing the forehead and cheeks, wavy lengths reaching upper chest over both shoulders. Preserve the source's casual slightly tousled hair, not a short straight bob or blonde hair.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL on TOP of the head, both fully visible inside the canvas with ample margin. Head sides at eye level are uninterrupted hair/fur: NO human ears, side ears, lower ears or fleshy lobes. The loose hood drapes around the back/sides of the head below the ears, so the TWO actual feline ears emerge naturally above the hood. Do not create extra fabric-shaped cat ears.
Clothing: fully clothed modest oversized pale pastel pink/lilac hoodie, hood visibly up loosely around the hair as in the source, thick soft fabric, ribbed neckline/cuffs if visible and relaxed shoulders. No text or logos. Omit the raised hand/forearm for the consistent clean avatar bust.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, wavy hair and sweatshirt fabric, warm brown outlines and ivory highlights, matching the existing character series.
Composition: square canvas, one centered nearly frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, eyes toward viewer and natural smiling face, rounded lower shoulder silhouette, all head, hair, ears and hood fully contained with generous transparent margins. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the blurred forest and all scenery. No other people, props, circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
